Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VPO_VHOW_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'المنفذ,المالك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VPO_TRVE_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم الشاسيه' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VPO_PL_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم اللوحة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_TRAN_DCRTN VARCHAR2(20);
 V_CURR_HIJDATE DATE := hijdate.Cur_Hij_Date;
 V_YEAR VARCHAR2(4):= TO_CHAR(V_CURR_HIJDATE,'YYYY');
 V_DATE DATE;
 V_TRAN_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_MAX_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_MAX_DATE DATE;
 V_EXCHANG_PORT VARCHAR2(100);

BEGIN

 IF :GLOBAL.FLAG = 1 THEN
 REC_TRANS;
 END IF;
 
IF :FROM_EXCHANG != 1 THEN
 
 SELECT MAX(TRANS_dATE_H) INTO V_MAX_DATE FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE PLATE_CTRY_CD = :CTRY_CD
 AND PLATE_CITY_CD = :CITY_CD
 AND PLATE_NO = :PLATE_NO
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.PORT_CD_P
 AND VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD = :VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD
 AND VHCL_CTGRY_CD = :VHCL_CTGRY_CD
 AND COLOR_CD = :COLOR_CD
 --AND PSNGR_CARG = :PARAMETER.PSNGR_CARG_P
 AND OWNER_SEQ = :OWNER_SEQ
 AND VHCL_CHASSIS_NO = :VHCL_CHASSIS_NO
 ;

 SELECT MAX(TRAN_SEQ) INTO V_MAX_SEQ FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = V_MAX_DATE
 AND PLATE_CTRY_CD = :CTRY_CD
 AND PLATE_CITY_CD = :CITY_CD
 AND PLATE_NO = :PLATE_NO
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.PORT_CD_P
 AND VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD = :VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD
 AND VHCL_CTGRY_CD = :VHCL_CTGRY_CD
 AND COLOR_CD = :COLOR_CD
 --AND PSNGR_CARG = :PARAMETER.PSNGR_CARG_P
 AND OWNER_SEQ = :OWNER_SEQ
 AND VHCL_CHASSIS_NO = :VHCL_CHASSIS_NO
 ;

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
 SELECT TRAN_SEQ,TRANS_DATE_H,TRAN_DRCTN INTO :TRANS_DATE.TRAN_SEQUENCE,:TRANS_DATE.TRANS_DATE,V_TRAN_DCRTN
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.PORT_CD_P
 AND TRANS_DATE_H = V_MAX_DATE
 AND TRAN_SEQ = V_MAX_SEQ
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN :TRAN_SEQUENCE := NULL;:TRANS_DATE.TRANS_DATE := NULL;:TRANS_DATE.TRAN_DCRTN := NULL;
END;
 -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT RV_MEANING INTO :TRAN_DCRTN FROM CG_REF_CODES
 WHERE RV_DOMAIN ='HAJ_TRANS_DRCTN'
 AND RV_LOW_VALUE = V_TRAN_DCRTN
 ;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ECHANGE_TEXT', VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :ECHANGE_TEXT := NULL;
ELSE
 
 
 IF :PARAMETER.PORT_CD_P = 41 THEN
 V_EXCHANG_PORT :=' قطر ';
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.PORT_CD_P = 31 THEN
 V_EXCHANG_PORT :=' الإمارات ';
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.PORT_CD_P IN(54,51,95) THEN
 V_EXCHANG_PORT :=' الأردن ';
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.PORT_CD_P IN (44,35) THEN
 V_EXCHANG_PORT :=' الكويت ';
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ECHANGE_TEXT', VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ECHANGE_TEXT', ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :TRAN_SEQUENCE := NULL;
 :TRANS_DATE.TRANS_DATE := NULL;
 :TRANS_DATE.TRAN_DCRTN := NULL;
 :ECHANGE_TEXT := 'بيانات '||V_EXCHANG_PORT;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ECHANGE_TEXT', FOREGROUND_COLOR,'r255g0b0');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ECHANGE_TEXT', BACKGROUND_COLOR,'r20g20b20');

END IF;

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VPO_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'COLOR_CD,CITY_CD,CTRY_CD,VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

FROM(

 :PLATES.VHCL_CTGRY_CD := V_VHCLS_REC.VHCL_CTGRY_CD;

 BEGIN

 ;

 ;
